DARE I SAY IT.Definition: if I may be bold enough to suggest it

ACQUIRED TASTE.Definition: something people only learn to like after trying it several times

OFF-LIMITS.Definition: not allowed to be talked or joked about

TABOO.Definition: not allowed or accepted because people find it offensive or shocking

IRONY.Definition: words that mean the opposite of what you really think

MOCK.Definition: laugh at someone or something in an unkind way

CONTEMPT.Definition: a feeling that someone or something is worthless and deserves no respect

CARDINAL SIN.Definition: a very serious mistake that breaks an important rule

SELF-DEPRECATION.Definition: making jokes about your own faults or weaknesses

STRAIGHT FACE.Definition: a serious expression that does not show you find something funny

MUTUAL UNDERSTANDING.Definition: something that everyone involved knows and agrees on without saying it

AMUSEMENT.Definition: the feeling of finding something funny

LAUGHTER TRACK.Definition: a recording of people laughing that is played during a TV show

ON SCREEN.Definition: in the TV show or film itself

COMPONENT.Definition: a part that, together with others, makes up something

STORYLINES.Definition: plots; the series of events that happen in the shows

MONOTONY.Definition: the boring sameness of something that never changes

ELABORATE.Definition: long and complicated, with many details

INNUENDO.Definition: remarks that suggest something rude, often sexual, without saying it directly

DOUBLE-ENTENDRE.Definition: a word or phrase with two meanings, one of them usually rude or sexual

DEADPAN DELIVERY.Definition: a way of telling something with a completely serious face and voice

STEREOTYPES.Definition: fixed, often unfair ideas about what a type of person is like

STEREOTYPICAL.Definition: matching a fixed, simple idea of what a group of people is like

STEREOTYPE.Definition: a fixed, often unfair idea about what a type of person is like

SHIPWRECKED.Definition: left stranded after their ship was destroyed at sea

SHY.Definition: nervous and uncomfortable with people they do not know

BIASED.Definition: likely to favour one side unfairly, because of my own connection to it
